title: Planning expansion contract binding
description: Objective: extend the authoritative PlanningRun command/state/event schema with exact expansion-hold and proposal-base bindings before behavior is enabled. Deliverable: immutable EXPANSION-specific fields are representable and validation remains exact/fail-closed, while INITIAL bytes and REVISION's unsupported status are preserved. NOT in scope: reducer transitions, scheduler admission, approval, resource/budget preparation, graph activation, or daemon persistence. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-command-contract.ts, planning-event-contract.ts, planning-validation.ts, and packages/core/src/expansion/planning-expansion-contract.test.ts. Production consumer: the Planning-run expansion submission child. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: PlanningRun EXPANSION commands/state/events represent the exact active hold generation/ref, parent node/run and worker handoff, proposal-base hash, goal version, graph epoch, source fingerprint, and sealed proposal identity without making those fields legal on INITIAL or REVISION records.

Validation enforces exact keys, bounded identifiers, canonical hashes, safe versions, matching run kind, and strong evidence truth; missing, extra, malformed, stale-shaped, or cross-kind fields fail closed with no normalized positive default.

Existing INITIAL command/state/event fixtures remain byte-compatible and REVISION remains representable but unsupported; no schema field grants child, graph, budget, resource, lease, effect, slot, or dispatch authority.

Focused production-surface tests assert accepted shapes and every invalid/cross-kind case, nonzero generated-case counts, immutability, and a mutation of the production exact-key/kind guard that turns the suite red.
The exact verification command exits 0, modified production files remain below 400 lines, and the submission child is recorded as the real consumer.
taskRails: Add fields to the existing PlanningRun contract; do not create a parallel authority schema.
An expansion hold binding is evidence of planning containment, never approval or activation.
